situation: A weary traveler at a roadside diner sits down to a steaming bowl of hot broth.
subject: the hot liquid food
brief: A heavy ceramic bowl sits at the center of a worn wooden counter, filled to the brim with a rich, steaming amber broth. Wisps of white steam rise vertically into the air, and a silver spoon rests half-submerged against the glossy interior rim of the bowl.
